title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Approving the Designation of the Sichuan Tianfu New District Chengdu Area People's Court and the Sichuan Pilot Free Trade Zone People's Court to Exercise Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Dispute Cases
keywords_en: intellectual property; court jurisdiction over partial intellectual property disputes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on Approving the Designation of the People's Court of Chengdu Area of Sichuan Tianfu New Area and the People's Court of Sichuan Pilot Free Trade Zone to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Disputes

Fa [2019] No. 71

Sichuan High People's Court:

Your Request for Designating the People's Court of Chengdu Area of Sichuan Tianfu New Area and the People's Court of Sichuan Pilot Free Trade Zone to Have Jurisdiction over Certain Intellectual Property Disputes (Chuan Gao Fa [2018] No. 320) has been received. Upon review, the reply is as follows:

It is approved that the People's Court of Chengdu Area of Sichuan Tianfu New Area and the People's Court of Sichuan Pilot Free Trade Zone shall have jurisdiction over first-instance general intellectual property civil cases occurring within their respective jurisdictions where the amount in controversy is below RMB 5 million. Excluded from such jurisdiction are cases concerning patents, new plant varieties, integrated circuit layout designs, technical secrets, computer software, monopoly disputes, and disputes involving the recognition of well-known trademarks.

This reply is hereby given.

March 18, 2019
